name: agents_benchmark
description: agents_benchmark evaluates the capabilities of autonomous/software agents on multi-step, interactive tasks that require planning, tool use, and environment interaction. It measures agents' ability to complete goals across a suite of scenarios and reports success/failure and related performance statistics. The benchmark is intended for comparing agent architectures and decision-making strategies.
evaluation_method: task_success_rate (with auxiliary metrics such as steps-to-success and reward)
reputation: A niche but growing benchmark hosted on Hugging Face used by practitioners evaluating agent behavior; not yet a broadly established community standard.
